verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents M2M applications under AuthKit Connect that issue API access credentials so callers can access APIs programmatically (workos-docs-32). It contrasts these with user-actor OAuth apps (workos-docs-45), and AuthKit is described as a spec-compatible OAuth authorization server (workos-docs-27), which together cover non-human service authentication. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the client-credentials grant and token issuance details, explicit coverage of agent or backend-service use cases beyond customer/partner API access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
